description: Geodata of Flood Water over Namacura and Maganja Da Costa District, Zambezia Province, Mozambique is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). This map illustrates satellite-detected flood waters in Maganja Da Costa and Namacura District of Zambezia Province, Mozambique, as detected by Radarsat-2 imagery acquired 03 February 2015. Between 18 January and 03 February, flood waters slightly decreased and affected roughly 52,700 hectars of land. Coverage: Mozambique. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are flooding, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-11-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
